hook: In a model, honeybee feeding peaks at a middling lingering rate that balances recruitment and jams
summary: A stochastic model couples bees searching toward chemical cues with random-order service at nectar donors. Fed bees linger and strengthen the cue, which attracts more searchers but also causes crowding. Feeding is fastest at an intermediate abandonment rate, and faster donors draw more recruits. The work is theoretical and is not tested against measured colonies.
title: Chemotactic recruitment offsets congestion in honeybee trophallaxis
